events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: On September 2nd, we remember the legendary Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still inspiring guitarists worldwide, Jimi Hendrix's legacy burns as brightly as his stage presence. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: Abbey Road released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Enduring Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years of 'Abbey Road'! That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. Which one is always on your playlist?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude defined a generation. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years of 'Imagine'. John Lennon's message of peace still resonates today. What does this album mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod turns 25 today! It changed music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit screens. Who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring genius of John Lennon. His music still inspires. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedy is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary Record
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. So diverse, so experimental. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: On November 24th, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Queen's King
angles.copy: Remembering the legend, Freddie Mercury, on the anniversary of his passing. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Evolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The album that marked a pivotal shift for The Beatles. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?
